title: add RAG agent tool-calling quickstarts and docs update
author: Elena Park
description: Motivation: provide first-party RAG agent quickstarts that demonstrate tool-calling, structured outputs, and template-driven RAG prompts for common developer scenarios (support assistant, knowledge search, codebase Q&A). This PR adds runnable examples, quickstart docs, and updates the docs site navigation. Changes include: new examples under redwood-examples/rag-agents (python and typescript), a set of parametrized RAG templates, tool adapter examples (search, calendar, external API), and docs site pages + sidebars. Checklist: - [x] Add runnable python + TS quickstarts - [x] Provide RAG prompt templates with template variables - [x] Add tool-calling adapter examples and mock servers for local testing - [x] Docs site pages, TOC and example snippets - [x] Unit/integration tests for example runners - [x] Confirm CI passes on examples matrix Context: customers frequently ask for end-to-end examples that combine retrieval-augmented generation with tool calling and structured outputs. This is a follow-up to DOC-98 and builds on previous RAG templates work (see related PRs). Implementation notes: - Quickstarts include env var-driven config so they work with hosted and private deployments. - Tool adapters are lightweight wrappers showing how to implement (1) search connector over vector DB, (2) web API adapter for external data, and (3) calendar lookup for scheduling workflows. - Templates are stored as YAML in examples/templates and support variable interpolation and a small evaluation harness for regression checks. - Docs site updates include a new 'RAG & Agents' section in the developer guides with sample flows and a troubleshooting subsection. Testing: added integration CI job to run examples against a mock local server and smoke test the generated outputs. Follow-ups: add additional language SDK examples (Go) and a recorded quickstart video.
commits: feat(rag-examples): add rag agent quickstarts and templates | docs(site): add RAG & Agents section + sidebar entries | test(examples): add integration smoke tests and CI job
